trial_court: MOTOR ACCIDENTS CLAIMS TRIBUNAL: NOTH WEST DISTRICT: ROHINI COURTS: DELHI
case_name: Smt. Sunita Devi W/O Late Sh. Satya ... vs Prem Suresh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Sunita Devi W/o Late Sh. Satya Narayan Chaudhary, Master Abhishek Chaudhary, Ms. Neha, Ms. Preeti, Shri Ram Chander Chaudhary (father of deceased)
parties.respondent_defendant: Sh. Prem Suresh S/o Sh. Dayal Suresh, Sh. Shailender Chauhan, New India Assurance Company Ltd.

facts_of_case: Accident occurred on 26.03.2007. Petitioners claim compensation for the same.

legal_principles.principle: When a witness is not cross-examined, their testimony shall be deemed to admit the same.
legal_principles.held: Nothing has appeared in the cross-examination of PW1 and PW2 to discredit their above said testimonies. PW1 and PW2 were not cross-examined by R1 and R2 and hence, they shall be deemed to admit the above said testimony.

legal_principles.principle: In the absence of any evidence to discredit a witness's testimony, it shall be deemed reliable.
legal_principles.held: Nothing has appeared in the cross-examination of PW1 and PW2 to discredit their above said testimonies.

outcome.final_order: The Tribunal awarded compensation to the petitioners.
